name: Cebidae
summary:
Jump into the action or chill with your fellow monkes! Whether you're battling it out in fast-paced PvP matches or just hanging out and making friends, there's something for everyone. Customize your look with a variety of fun cosmetics and show off your unique style!

Please note: this is an early release, so you might run into some bugs — but don’t worry, we’re actively working on improvements and exciting new content. Big updates and new features are on the way soon!
